home.all_done_sub: Review what you learned while more content arrives

retos.title: Challenges & goals
retos.shield_body: Saves your streak on a day you miss the goal.
retos.nothing_yet_body: Start today's lesson and the challenges take care of themselves

test.hint: Pick what you think. If you don't know, say so: it places you better than guessing.
test.banner_body: Take the placement test and start where you belong, not from zero.
test.intro_body: Blocks of {{n}} questions, from easy to hard. You stop as soon as it gets tough.
test.intro_point1: You start where you belong, not from zero.
test.intro_point2: If you don't know something, say so: no penalty.
test.intro_point3: At the end we explain every mistake.
test.block_top_body: {{correct}} of {{total}} in {{level}}: that is the highest level we have today.
test.block_stop_body: {{correct}} of {{total}} in {{level}}. That is exactly where there is something to learn.

practica.title: Conversation with corrections
practica.subtitle: Talk like in real life. If you slip up, I correct you before moving on and explain why.
practica.goal_cafe: Order a coffee and something to eat
practica.goal_intro: Name, where you're from, what you do
practica.goal_travel: Check in and ask about luggage
practica.goal_flat: Ask about the rent and the area
practica.privacy: Your messages are sent to the AI to be corrected. We don't store the conversation.
practica.mic_denied: Your browser blocked the microphone. Allow it in the site permissions.
practica.mic_failed: Couldn't use the microphone. Try again or type your answer.

escucha.title: Fill in what you hear
escucha.subtitle: Listen to the sentence and fill the gaps. Replay it as many times as you like.
escucha.note: Original Parlo content, read with your device's voice. You can change the voice in your profile.
escucha.solution: Listen again with the answer in front of you
escucha.how_title: How to get the most out of it
escucha.how_1: Listen to the whole sentence before writing anything: get the gist first.
escucha.how_2: If a word escapes you, tap the turtle: same sentence, slower.
escucha.how_3: Do not translate in your head. If you get the idea, you are doing fine.

leer.title: Read in English
leer.subtitle: Upload a text or PDF and read it with audio, translation and word meanings.
leer.upload_hint: TXT, MD, PDF, DOCX or EPUB · stays on your device
leer.privacy: Documents are stored on this device only. Individual sentences are sent to the AI when you ask for a translation.
leer.err_type: Format not supported. Use TXT, MD, PDF, DOCX or EPUB.
leer.err_scanned: That PDF is a scanned image with no readable text.
leer.vocab_hint: The most repeated words in the document that you do not have yet
leer.vocab_none: No new words left to add

pronunciacion.home_sub: Read out loud and check if you are understood

liga.title: Compete with whoever you choose
liga.subtitle: A private league of up to 20 people. Whoever earns the most XP this week wins.
liga.privacy_1: Only your alias and your XP for the week.
liga.privacy_2: Never your email, your lessons or when you study.
liga.privacy_3: You can leave whenever you want: your score is deleted.
liga.alias_chars: Only letters, numbers, spaces and . _ - (no emails or phone numbers).
liga.create_body: You create it and share the code.
liga.join_body: Ask whoever invited you for the 6-letter code.
liga.err_not_found: We could not find that league. Check the code.
liga.alone: It is just you so far. Share the code and let the competition begin.
liga.leave_confirm: Are you sure? Your score in this league will be deleted.
liga.footer: Standings reset every Monday. Only the XP you earn during the week counts.
